content.title: Northrop Grumman Launches Cygnus XL to International Space Station
content.caption: Northrop Grumman launches Cygnus XL spacecraft to the International Space Station, marking a significant milestone in space exploration.

slides.heading: Northrop Grumman Launches Cygnus XL to International Space Station
slides.text: Northrop Grumman launches Cygnus XL spacecraft to the International Space Station, marking a significant milestone in space exploration.

slides.heading: Launch Details
slides.text: The Cygnus XL spacecraft, carrying approximately 11,000 pounds of cargo, is set to launch from Space Launch Complex 40 in Florida.

slides.heading: Mission Overview
slides.text: The mission, known as NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 25, or Northrop Grumman CRS-25, is delivering science investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station.
